props.name: schema
props.comment: A JSON Schema the value is checked against. Object shape only.

props.name: schemaUri
props.comment: A schema Monaco fetches from this URL. Ignored when `schema` is set.

props.name: allowComments
props.comment: Tolerate comments and trailing commas in the text.

props.name: autoHeight
props.comment: Grow with the content between `minHeight` and `maxHeight`. Defaults to false.

props.name: height
props.comment: Editor height in pixels when `autoHeight` is false. Defaults to 300.

props.name: minHeight
props.comment: Shortest the editor gets when `autoHeight` is on. Defaults to 120.

props.name: maxHeight
props.comment: Tallest the editor grows to when `autoHeight` is on. Defaults to 600.

props.name: showFormatButton
props.comment: Show the Format button. Defaults to true.

props.name: monacoOptions
props.comment: Merged over the editor defaults, so it can override any of them.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path (dot/bracket), relative to the ambient source scope.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default (seeds only into a hole), typed as the value at `source`.

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
